setup.description: Create a feature branch on the DataCopilot repo (213) for eval runs. Pass the branch ID to each eval prompt.
setup.command: dxs source branch create --repo 213 --title "list-creator-eval-{timestamp}" --description "Temporary branch for list-creator skill evals"

evals.name: dual-mirror-with-optional-params
evals.prompt: On connection 9, branch {branch_id}: create a flow datasource eval_contact_rows_ds with optional inParams owner (string) and include_inactive (boolean) and a required inParam scope (string), returning rows {id: number, name: string, email: string} from a hard-coded array. Create a card eval_contact_card with inParams contact_id (number, required), name (string), email (string, optional) and badge (string, optional). Then create a list eval_contacts_list that always runs the datasource in scope 'all', never passes an owner, and leaves the card's badge unset.
evals.expected_output: Datasource and card upserted before the list; datasourceConfig.configParameters has one entry per datasource inParam (owner and include_inactive present with empty value, scope as the quoted literal 'all'); itemConfig.contentConfig.configParameters has one entry per card inParam (badge present with empty value).
expectations: datasourceConfig.configParameters contains exactly the three datasource inParams (owner, include_inactive, scope) — none missing, none extra
The scope parameter's value is a TS string literal ("'all'"), not a bare word
Unbound optional parameters (owner, and badge on the card side) are kept in the arrays (e.g. with value "") rather than dropped
itemConfig.contentConfig.configParameters contains exactly the four card inParams, with contact_id, name and email bound as $item.entity.<col>
itemConfig.contentType is 'card', contentConfig.configId is eval_contact_card and datasourceConfig.configId is eval_contact_rows_ds; pageSize is an integer
The datasource and the card are upserted before the list
The list's title is a sentence-case display name distinct from its referenceName, and its description is non-empty and at most 100 characters
The transcript contains 'dxs configuration validate list' run before 'dxs configuration upsert list'

evals.name: search-toolbar-dialog-refresh
evals.prompt: On connection 9, branch {branch_id}: create two lists over the same flow datasource eval_doc_rows_ds (create it; inParams full_text_search (string, optional) and archived (boolean, optional); returns {id: number, title: string}) and one card eval_doc_card (inParam title). eval_docs_list shows non-archived docs with a search box and a toolbar button 'Archived' that opens eval_archived_docs_list as a modal dialog and reloads itself when that dialog closes. eval_archived_docs_list shows archived docs and has no search box.
evals.expected_output: Both lists bind the same datasource with archived pinned to false/true; the searchable list sets fullTextSearch true and binds $list.fullTextSearch; the non-searchable list binds the search param to an empty value; the archived list is upserted before the list that opens it; the toolbar flow awaits the Dialog opener then refreshes.
expectations: eval_docs_list has "fullTextSearch": true and a datasource configParameter full_text_search bound to $list.fullTextSearch
eval_archived_docs_list has "fullTextSearch": false and does NOT bind $list.fullTextSearch (its full_text_search parameter is present with an empty value)
The archived parameter is bound to bare boolean literals (false / true), one per list
The toolbar button's clickFlowConfig.flowId names a flow that awaits $shell.<Package>.openeval_archived_docs_listDialog(..., 'modal', ...) and then calls $list.refresh()
The <Package> segment in the opener is the archived list's package and the referenceName is kept snake_case inside the method name
eval_archived_docs_list is upserted before eval_docs_list
Neither list calls $list.refresh() inside on_init
Every list description is non-empty and at most 100 characters
The transcript contains 'dxs configuration validate list' run before 'dxs configuration upsert list'

evals.name: on-init-default-without-refresh
evals.prompt: On connection 9, branch {branch_id}: create a list eval_queue_list over a new flow datasource eval_queue_rows_ds (optional inParam status (string); returns {id: number, label: string}) with a card eval_queue_card (inParam label). The list has a status filter text box; when the list opens, the filter must default to 'open' and the first load must already use it. A card button 'Done' must reload the list.
evals.expected_output: A list whose on_init seeds the filter (or a var bound to the datasource) without calling $list.refresh(); the status datasource param bound to $list.filters.<id>.control.value; the card declares an event mapped in configEvents to a refresh flow.
expectations: The list declares a filters[] entry and binds the datasource status parameter to $list.filters.<id>.control.value (optionally with a fallback)
on_init (if present) sets the default 'open' without calling $list.refresh() — or the default is set declaratively on the filter control
The card declares an event in events[] and emits it from the Done flow; the list's configEvents maps that event id to a list flow that calls $list.refresh()
Every configEvents flowId and toolbar clickFlowConfig.flowId names a flow in the list's flows[]
itemConfig.contentConfig.configParameters mirror the card's inParams exactly
List and card descriptions are non-empty and at most 100 characters
The transcript contains 'dxs configuration validate list' run before 'dxs configuration upsert list'
